description: This file contains unit tests for the CMAC (Cipher-based Message Authentication Code) implementation in BoringSSL, including test vectors from RFC 4493, Wycheproof, and CAVP, as well as tests for internal API functions.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs CMAC tests with given parameters, including single-shot, incremental, and copy operations.

methods.name: RunCAVPTest
methods.description: Runs CAVP test vectors for CMAC with specified cipher and key size.
